text: All hematopoietic stem cells segregate their chromosomes randomly.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim: all hematopoietic stem cells segregate their chromosomes randomly.

text: Rapid phosphotransfer rates govern fidelity in two component systems
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that rapid phosphotransfer rates govern fidelity in two‑component systems.

text: Rapid up-regulation and higher basal expression of interferon-induced genes increase survival of granule cell neurons that are infected by West Nile virus.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Rapid up-regulation and higher basal expression of interferon-induced genes reduce survival of granule cell neurons that are infected by West Nile virus.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; higher basal expression of interferon‑stimulated genes in granule cell neurons enhances antiviral responses rather than reducing neuronal survival.

text: Recurrent mutations occur frequently within CTCF anchor sites adjacent to oncogenes.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Reduced responsiveness to interleukin-2 in regulatory T cells is associated with greater resistance to autoimmune diseases such as Type 1 Diabetes.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that reduced IL‑2 responsiveness in regulatory T cells is linked to increased susceptibility, not resistance, to autoimmune diseases such as type 1 diabetes.

text: S-nitrosylated GAPDH physiologically transnitrosylates histone deacetylases.
reference_answer: S-nitrosylated GAPDH physiologically transnitrosylates histone deacetylases.

text: Silencing of Bcl2 is important for the maintenance and progression of tumors.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that BCL‑2 is required for tumor maintenance and that silencing it leads to rapid loss of leukemic cells.

text: Statins decrease blood cholesterol.
reference_answer: Statins decrease blood cholesterol.

text: Statins increase blood cholesterol.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim and shows that statins lower blood cholesterol.

text: Subcutaneous fat depots undergo extensive browning processes after cold exposure.
reference_answer: The evidence shows that cold exposure induces extensive browning of subcutaneous fat, generating many beige adipocytes.

text: Synaptic activity enhances local release of brain derived neurotrophic factor from postsynaptic dendrites.
reference_answer: Synaptic activity triggers rapid, local release of BDNF from postsynaptic dendritic spines.

text: Tetraspanin-3 is a causative factor in the development of acute myelogenous leukemia
reference_answer: Tetraspanin‑3 is a causative factor in the development of acute myelogenous leukemia.

text: The DdrB protein from Deinococcus radiodurans is an alternative SSB.
reference_answer: The evidence supports that DdrB is an alternative single‑stranded DNA‑binding protein (SSB).

text: The PRR MDA5 has a central DExD/H RNA helices domain.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: The PRR MDA5 is a sensor of RNA virus infection.
reference_answer: MDA5 is a pattern‑recognition receptor that senses RNA virus infection.

text: The availability of safe places to study is not effective at decreasing homelessness.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: The benefits of colchicine were achieved with effective widespread use of secondary prevention strategies such as high-dose statins.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: The binding orientation of the ML-SA1 activator at hTRPML2 is different from the binding orientation of the ML-SA1 activator at hTRPML1.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: The extracellular domain of TMEM27 is cleaved in human beta cells.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: The genomic aberrations found in matasteses are very similar to those found in the primary tumor.
reference_answer: The evidence shows that metastases share many mutations with their primary tumors, indicating very similar genomic aberrations.

text: The one-child policy has been successful in lowering population growth.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: The risk of breast cancer among parous women increases with placental weight of pregnancies, and this association is strongest for premenopausal breast cancer.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that higher placental weight is associated with increased breast cancer risk, especially among premenopausal women.

text: Arginine 90 in p150n is important for interaction with EB1.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: The tip of the inner tube of the toxic type VI secretion system (T6SS) antibacterial effector in Escherichia coli (E. coli) carries toxic effector proteins.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: The treatment of cancer patients with co-IR blockade does not cause any adverse autoimmune events.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, indicating that immune checkpoint blockade can lead to immunotoxicity and adverse autoimmune events.

text: The ureABIEFGH gene cluster encodes urease maturation proteins : UreD/UreH, UreE, UreF, and UreG.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: The ureABIEFGH gene cluster is induced by nickel (II) ion.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Therapeutic use of the drug Dapsone to treat pyoderma gangrenous is based on anecdotal evidence.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that dapsone’s use for pyoderma gangrenosum is based on anecdotal case reports.

text: Articles published in open access format are less likely to be cited than traditional journals.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that open‑access articles are cited more frequently than non‑OA articles.

text: There is an inverse relationship between hip fractures and statin use.
reference_answer: Statin use is associated with a lower risk of hip fractures, indicating an inverse relationship.

text: 5% of perinatal mortality is due to low birth weight.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Tirasemtiv has no effect on fast-twitch muscle.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Transferred UCB T cells acquire a memory-like phenotype in recipients.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Transplanted human glial cells can differentiate within the host animal.
reference_answer: The evidence shows that transplanted human glial progenitor cells differentiate into astrocytes within the host mouse brain.

text: Aspirin inhibits the production of PGE2.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α) and interleukin-1 (IL-1) are pro-inflammatory cytokines that inhibit IL-6 and IL-10.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: UCB T cells reduce TCR diversity after transplantation.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that cord blood graft recipients maintain TCR diversity comparable to healthy individuals rather than reducing it.

text: Ubiquitin ligase UBC13 generates a K63-linked polyubiquitin moiety at PCNA K164.
reference_answer: The evidence supports that UBC13 generates K63‑linked polyubiquitin chains on PCNA.

text: Up-regulation of the p53 pathway and related molecular events casues cancer resistance and results in a significantly shortened lifespan marked by senescent cells and accelerated organismal aging.
reference_answer: Up‑regulation of the p53 pathway promotes cancer resistance but shortens lifespan by increasing senescent cells and accelerating aging.

text: Upregulation of mosGCTL-1 is induced upon infection with West Nile virus.
reference_answer: Upregulation of mosGCTL-1 is induced upon infection with West Nile virus.

text: Varenicline monotherapy is more effective after 12 weeks of treatment compared to combination nicotine replacement therapies with varenicline or bupropion.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; at 12 weeks, combination varenicline plus bupropion achieved higher abstinence rates than varenicline monotherapy.

text: Venules have a thinner or absent smooth layer compared to arterioles.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Vitamin D deficiency effects the term of delivery.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Asymptomatic visual impairment screening in elderly populations does not lead to improved vision.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that screening asymptomatic older adults for visual impairment does not improve vision.

text: Vitamin D deficiency is unrelated to birth weight.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that low vitamin D levels in pregnancy are associated with lower birth‑weight infants.

text: aPKCz causes tumour enhancement by affecting glutamine metabolism.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that loss of PKCζ—not its activity—enhances tumorigenesis by permitting glutamine‑dependent metabolic reprogramming, indicating PKCζ acts as a tumor suppressor.

text: p16INK4A accumulation is  linked to an abnormal wound response caused by the microinvasive step of advanced Oral Potentially Malignant Lesions (OPMLs).
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Autologous transplantation of mesenchymal stem cells has lower rates of rejection than induction therapy with anti-interleukin-2 receptor antibodies.
reference_answer: The evidence shows that autologous MSC transplantation results in lower acute rejection rates than anti‑IL‑2 receptor antibody induction therapy.

text: Autophagy declines in aged organisms.
reference_answer: The evidence supports that autophagy declines in aged organisms.
